mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) above 2% annualized signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL annualized > 2%.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 4% signals a tight labor market, which leads to wage inflation and increased corporate costs, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where UNRATE < 4%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month increase in housing starts (HOUST) signals strong consumer demand, which boosts corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of instances with sustained 3-month increase in HOUST.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 1% month-over-month signals a weakening supply side, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where INDPRO MoM decrease > 1%.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 2% and CPIAUCSL annualized is below 1.5%, the real interest rate is high, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS > 2% and CPIAUCSL annualized < 1.5%.

mechanism_narrative: When nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) increase by more than 200,000 and the unemployment rate (UNRATE) decreases by more than 0.2 percentage points, it signals a strong labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of instances where PAYEMS increase > 200,000 and UNRATE decrease > 0.2pp.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month increase in real final sales (RSAFS) signals strong consumer demand, which boosts corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of instances with sustained 3-month increase in RSAFS.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) increases by more than 2% year-over-year and the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is below 1%, it signals a strong supply side with accommodative monetary policy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
regime_hint: accommodative monetary policy with strong supply
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of instances where INDPRO YoY increase > 2% and FEDFUNDS < 1%.
